english.note: For physical side-to-side width, 闊 is the all-purpose spoken choice.
Use 闊 as the all-purpose choice for something wide in physical extent.

examples.english: This table is wide enough for three people to eat together.
examples.traditional: 呢張枱夠闊，三個人一齊食飯都得。
